notes: Per-fighter joint-role map used by scripts/render/Retarget.gd to drive the SVR2011 wrestler skeletons from the SSB64 joint trees.

Joint ids are fp.joints[] indices (== hitbox/hurtbox joint_id). Coordinates quoted below are bind-pose world positions (DObjDesc, TopN unrotated, x attr.size) computed from data/ssb64/fighters/<kind>.json: SSB +X = character's left, +Z = facing, so l_* roles use the +X joints.

Limb roles (upper arm, forearm, thigh, shin) are direction-aligned: the wrestler bone axis is kept on the SSB segment joint -> limb_child (child bind translate in the joint frame, every SSB limb runs along local +X) and twist follows the SSB joint frame via a rest-pose canonical frame (axis + facing reference). Other roles (hips, chest, neck, head, hands, feet) transfer the world rotation delta relative to the bind pose. 'spine' (koshi) gets the halfway slerp between hips and chest deltas.
Same joint for upper arm and forearm (Pikachu) = single-segment SSB arm, wrestler arm kept straight. Missing roles (null) leave the wrestler bone at its rest pose relative to its parent.

measured.* (SSB world units, Wait pose frame 0, lr=+1) are written by scripts/test/measure_retarget.gd: standing_height = top of the highest hurtbox, hip_height = hips joint height, used for the wrestler scale (standing height match) and the hip-height ratio that maps the SSB hips position onto the wrestler pelvis.

blend (optional, per role): 0..1 slerp from the wrestler's rest local rotation to the SSB-driven one, used to tame the very short, wildly swinging limbs of the ball-shaped / quadruped fighters (Kirby, Jigglypuff arms+legs, Pikachu arms) on a full-size human body.
